p16/esc228:10.speaker: supporter
p16/esc228:10.text: Have you had that conversation with him? I know it might be a difficult conversation to have, but it is often good to get expectations out in the open so you are on the same page with your partner.

p16/esc228:11.speaker: seeker
p16/esc228:11.text: Yes, sort of and he gave me the impression that he is not there yet and that was a like almost a year ago, I don't want it to look like I'm pushing him if I try to talk to him again about it. His nonchalant attitude in not seeing the seriousness of it is killing me, I'm just not happy.

p16/esc228:12.speaker: supporter
p16/esc228:12.text: That is tough, but sometimes people just portray things differently, for instance I am also very laid back and nonchalant about most things which can lead to miscommunications.

p16/esc228:13.speaker: supporter
p16/esc228:13.text: I don't think it would be pushing if you haven't had that conversation in almost a year.

p16/esc228:14.speaker: seeker
p16/esc228:14.text: I hope you are right, just don't want to come across as a desperate person and that's why I'm setting myself up to call it quits if he tries to sound like he sounded the last time.

p16/esc228:15.speaker: supporter
p16/esc228:15.text: You need to know where he is so you can make a good decision for yourself!

p16/esc228:16.speaker: supporter
p16/esc228:16.text: I know it is difficult, but I know you can get through it!

p16/esc228:17.speaker: seeker
p16/esc228:17.text: You are right, that's exactly what I'm going to do because the wait is killing me.

p16/esc228:18.speaker: supporter
p16/esc228:18.text: Good, I am happy for you!

p16/esc228:19.speaker: seeker
p16/esc228:19.text: Thank you very much, you've been a great help

p16/esc228:2.speaker: supporter
p16/esc228:2.text: I am good, how are you?

p16/esc228:20.speaker: supporter
p16/esc228:20.text: I am glad I was able to help!

p16/esc228:21.speaker: seeker
p16/esc228:21.text: Thanks, it was nice chatting with you.

p16/esc228:22.speaker: supporter
p16/esc228:22.text: You're welcome! If you need any more help just chat back with us again.

p16/esc228:3.speaker: seeker
p16/esc228:3.text: I'm doing well, but it could have been better

p16/esc228:4.speaker: supporter
p16/esc228:4.text: What seems to be bothering you tonight?

p16/esc228:5.speaker: seeker
p16/esc228:5.text: Yes, my boy friend of 3 years has refused to take our relationship to the next level and I'm kind of getting tired, I don't want to play games anymore

p16/esc228:6.speaker: supporter
p16/esc228:6.text: So just to make sure I understand completely, you are ready to move on to the next step of your relationship and you don't feel as though your boyfriend is and this is making you anxious and upset,

p16/esc228:7.speaker: seeker
p16/esc228:7.text: exactly, I hate to feel that I'm wasting my time

p16/esc228:8.speaker: supporter
p16/esc228:8.text: I completely understand that, as I was in a long term relationship and I felt as though my girlfriend at the time did not want to take things to the next step and I was not happy about it.

p16/esc228:9.speaker: seeker
p16/esc228:9.text: Yes, I love him so dearly to want to settle down with him, but if he doesn't want that for me I would rather call it quits now than continue and be disappointed at the long run.

p16/esc371:10.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:10.text: I had a similar issue at my last job. My supervisor constantly spoke over me in meetings, and it would drive me crazy. I never could get a word in edge-wise.

p16/esc371:11.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:11.text: Yeah, that sounds a lot like what I am experiencing

p16/esc371:13.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:13.text: It's been in the back of my mind, but it's a hard time just now with everything else going on

p16/esc371:14.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:14.text: Absolutely. It's a rough time job searching under the best of circumstances.

p16/esc371:16.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:16.text: Have you tried reaching out to anyone in your network to look for a new position? It helped me when I was previously job searching.

p16/esc371:17.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:17.text: I haven't, but it might be worth getting in touch with some people

p16/esc371:18.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:18.text: Absolutely. I also spoke with a therapist before and it helped me a lot.

p16/esc371:19.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:19.text: Have you considered reaching out to a professional to talk to?

p16/esc371:2.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:2.text: I'm not doing so good at the moment. I'm feeling very stressed and burned out from work

p16/esc371:20.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:20.text: I did consider that, but aren't they expensive?

p16/esc371:21.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:21.text: They can be, but many local governments and municipalities have therapists that work on a sliding scale if the financial aspect of therapy is a concern.

p16/esc371:22.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:22.text: Therapy can definitely be a large expense though.

p16/esc371:23.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:23.text: It might be worth it in the long run though I guess, if it helps how I am feeling

p16/esc371:24.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:24.text: If it helps to reframe the expense, you can try to think of it as an investment in your mental health.

p16/esc371:25.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:25.text: Yes, that sounds like a more positive way of thinking of it

p16/esc371:26.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:26.text: The therapist could likely give you some tools to help manage the frustrations at your workplace more constructively.

p16/esc371:27.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:27.text: Yes, I imagine they will have come across this before so will be able to help

p16/esc371:28.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:28.text: Absolutely. I hope that you're able to find some peace at your workplace with your boss.

p16/esc371:29.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:29.text: Thank you, you have helped a lot

p16/esc371:3.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:3.text: That sounds very frustrating. Is this a recent development at your job?

p16/esc371:30.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:30.text: Helped give me some ideas to try to help

p16/esc371:31.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:31.text: It's my pleasure. I'm happy to have helped you.

p16/esc371:32.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:32.text: Is there anything else I can help you with?

p16/esc371:4.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:4.text: It's been building up for a while now, but it's really starting to get a but overwhelming

p16/esc371:5.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:5.text: I can understand how that can have an effect on your mental well-being. Have you spoken to your supervisor about your frustrations at work?

p16/esc371:6.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:6.text: I have, but sometimes I feel like she doesn't really listen and she sort of talks over me a lot

p16/esc371:7.speaker: supporter
p16/esc371:7.text: It sounds like you don't feel listened to.

p16/esc371:8.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:8.text: That's right... I guess that is quite a lot of the problem.

p16/esc371:9.speaker: seeker
p16/esc371:9.text: I don't mind so much the work, I know it is busy for everyone right now, it's a combination of the workload plus not being listened to

p16/esc538:0.speaker: supporter
p16/esc538:0.text: Hello, how are you doing today?

p16/esc538:1.speaker: seeker
p16/esc538:1.text: I am feeling angry today about work.

p16/esc538:10.speaker: supporter
p16/esc538:10.text: Tell her the things that you like about her method and maybe suggest some of your methods to her as well. Maybe she'll find them to be more efficient. Make it a partnership rather than a fight for whose method is better.

p16/esc538:11.speaker: supporter
p16/esc538:11.text: She could feel threatened by you so it's worth digging into those feelings with her and proving to her that you're working toward the same goal.

p16/esc538:12.speaker: seeker
p16/esc538:12.text: That's a great idea. It is possible. I am the new kid on the block. I will try by being non confrontational. Any specific ideas to how  I can do that? She gets offended easily. I want her to know I am helping.

p16/esc538:13.speaker: supporter
p16/esc538:13.text: I'd suggest how much she's helped you since you are in fact the new kid on the block.  And tell her that you want to work with her to have the most efficient partnership possible and use each of your talents to the best of your ability. Then you can lay out how you work best and see where it goes from there.

p16/esc538:14.speaker: seeker
p16/esc538:14.text: Thanks! I will try that. You made me feel so much better!

p16/esc538:15.speaker: supporter
p16/esc538:15.text: I'm so glad, these can be frustrating situations but sometimes it's worth looking at the other person's perspective.

p16/esc538:16.speaker: seeker
p16/esc538:16.text: I agree. Sometimes you just have to take a step back and have a conversation with someone not in the thick of it.

p16/esc538:17.speaker: supporter
p16/esc538:17.text: Absolutely, I have no emotional stake in this. The two of you do and that can cloud things sometimes.

p16/esc538:18.speaker: seeker
p16/esc538:18.text: I think people get territorial when they have worked somewhere and a new person comes in. I see that now. I am optimistic we will work it out and be a great team!

p16/esc538:19.speaker: supporter
p16/esc538:19.text: That's great to hear, I'm glad we were able to chat!

p16/esc538:2.speaker: supporter
p16/esc538:2.text: Oh no, what happened to make you feel this way?

p16/esc538:20.speaker: seeker
p16/esc538:20.text: Me too! You really helped me. Have a wonderful day! I know I will since you helped me out.

p16/esc538:3.speaker: seeker
p16/esc538:3.text: My coworker expects me to do things the way she does and is constantly critical. I just want her to understand that I am able to do things my way and it is still okay. I told her this and she ignored me.

p16/esc538:4.speaker: supporter
p16/esc538:4.text: I'm sure that's terribly frustrating having someone treat you like that. Is this something that your boss is aware of?

p16/esc538:5.speaker: seeker
p16/esc538:5.text: I have not told her yet. I do not want to get her into trouble and I want to have a good relationship with her.

p16/esc538:6.speaker: supporter
p16/esc538:6.text: Can you discuss it with her in a respectful way to get her to understand that you're not trying to undermine her but that this is how you work most efficiently? And maybe mention that you don't want to involve the boss?

p16/esc538:7.speaker: seeker
p16/esc538:7.text: That's something I could try. I really care about my coworker and it makes me so angry that she treats me this way.

p16/esc538:8.speaker: supporter
p16/esc538:8.text: I think sometimes it's easy to jump to anger when you feel hurt. It might be worth telling her how you feel and also maybe ask why she thinks you should be doing things her way. Maybe there's a give and take in this situation. Some of her methods could be beneficial.

p16/esc538:9.speaker: seeker
p16/esc538:9.text: Do you have any advice on how to start my conversation with her? I have found some of her ideas to be beneficial. I just would like my ideas expressed as well. I feel we can learn from each other.

p16/esc915:0.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:0.text: I feel sad, and feel like need help

p16/esc915:1.speaker: supporter
p16/esc915:1.text: Can you identify why you feel sad?

p16/esc915:10.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:10.text: I talk to my family, but the whole family is not doing really fine

p16/esc915:11.speaker: supporter
p16/esc915:11.text: It sounds like you feel people think you are complaining when you talk about your Aunt's death making you sad.    Is that correct?

p16/esc915:13.speaker: supporter
p16/esc915:13.text: Do you feel you are complaining?

p16/esc915:14.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:14.text: yes, I feel like noone wants to listen

p16/esc915:15.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:15.text: I need to do something by mnyself

p16/esc915:16.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:16.text: Can you recommend someting for me to do to feel better?

p16/esc915:17.speaker: supporter
p16/esc915:17.text: My own experiences with family deaths is they are sad.    I just wanted to "feel better".    My experience was it did not help to complain about "being sad" but it did help to talk about why I missed my family member.     If no one was available,   sometimes I would journal.   Do you think that might help you?

p16/esc915:18.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:18.text: Well maybe it could works, to mantain distracted

p16/esc915:2.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:2.text: yes, my aunt pass away a couple weeks ago

p16/esc915:20.speaker: supporter
p16/esc915:20.text: You are welcome.    I am sorry about your Aunt.

p16/esc915:21.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:21.text: Thnak you, I think it helps to have someone to chat

p16/esc915:22.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:22.text: Makes me feel better to chat a bit with you, helped me to relax

p16/esc915:23.speaker: supporter
p16/esc915:23.text: That is why I am here.     Is there anything else you would like to chat about?

p16/esc915:24.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:24.text: I hink, Im fine for now. I will try to keep myself focus on different things

p16/esc915:25.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:25.text: and try to chat a bit more at leaat with my family

p16/esc915:3.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:3.text: and since then im feeling really sad

p16/esc915:4.speaker: supporter
p16/esc915:4.text: It is natural to feel sad when someone you care about dies.

p16/esc915:5.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:5.text: IS there something I can do to feel better?

p16/esc915:6.speaker: supporter
p16/esc915:6.text: Are you with family?   Sometimes it helps to be with others who are grieving?

p16/esc915:7.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:7.text: No, I live alone, my family lives in another state

p16/esc915:8.speaker: supporter
p16/esc915:8.text: Being by yourself is rough after a death.    Can you talk with your family by phone?   Do you have a friend who has gone through a similar loss?

p16/esc915:9.speaker: seeker
p16/esc915:9.text: I feel like everybody is in their own bussines and have no time to hear my complains

p16/p16_conv_1:0.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_1:0.text: Hi Amanda, it's good to see you online. How have you been doing lately?

p16/p16_conv_1:1.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_1:1.text: Hey! I've been feeling a bit off after attending my aunt's memorial service last week.

p16/p16_conv_1:10.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_1:10.text: That's a great step forward. How does it feel to have taken that initiative?

p16/p16_conv_1:11.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_1:11.text: A little reassuring, honestly. But there's still this nagging feeling of having missed out on so much with them.

p16/p16_conv_1:12.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_1:12.text: It's natural to feel that way, but it's important to give yourself grace. Every relationship has its own timeline.

p16/p16_conv_1:13.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_1:13.text: You're right. I guess I should focus on making the most of the present.

p16/p16_conv_1:14.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_1:14.text: That's a positive perspective. How do you plan to keep your connections going from here?

p16/p16_conv_1:15.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_1:15.text: I'm thinking of arranging a small family gathering, something more joy-filled, to keep everyone in touch.

p16/p16_conv_1:16.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_1:16.text: That sounds like a wonderful idea! It could be a new tradition that brings everyone closer.

p16/p16_conv_1:17.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_1:17.text: I hope so. It feels good just talking about it. Thanks for listening and helping me work through this.

p16/p16_conv_1:18.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_1:18.text: Anytime, Amanda. Remember, you're taking meaningful steps. Keep nurturing those connections.

p16/p16_conv_1:2.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_1:2.text: I'm sorry to hear that. It must have been an emotional experience for you.

p16/p16_conv_1:3.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_1:3.text: Yeah, it really was. Not only because we were saying goodbye, but also because I got to see so many relatives I hadn't seen in years.

p16/p16_conv_1:4.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_1:4.text: That sounds like it brought up a lot of feelings. How did that affect you?

p16/p16_conv_1:5.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_1:5.text: It was bittersweet. On one hand, it was wonderful to reconnect, but on the other hand, it made me realize how distant I've become from them.

p16/p16_conv_1:6.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_1:6.text: It sounds like you're processing a mix of emotions—grief and perhaps some regret?

p16/p16_conv_1:7.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_1:7.text: Exactly. I feel guilty for not staying in touch more. It was strange talking about memories with people I used to be so close to.

p16/p16_conv_1:8.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_1:8.text: That's understandable. Guilt can be hard to shake off, but reconnecting at the memorial could be a new beginning.

p16/p16_conv_1:9.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_1:9.text: I hope so. I exchanged numbers with a few of them and promised to keep in touch.

p16/p16_conv_2:0.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_2:0.text: Hey, I just needed someone to talk to and thought of you.

p16/p16_conv_2:1.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_2:1.text: Of course, Amanda. I'm here for you. What's on your mind?

p16/p16_conv_2:10.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_2:10.text: It got me thinking about my aunt's memorial service, too, and how I reconnected with my family then.

p16/p16_conv_2:11.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_2:11.text: Those events can open old wounds and start new chapters. How has reconnecting with your family been?

p16/p16_conv_2:12.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_2:12.text: It's been good but also overwhelming. There are so many emotions to process, especially with reconnecting after so long.

p16/p16_conv_2:13.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_2:13.text: It sounds like you've been navigating a lot of complex feelings. It's natural to feel overwhelmed.

p16/p16_conv_2:14.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_2:14.text: Yeah, it can be hard sometimes. But at work, at least, things feel like they're on a better track.

p16/p16_conv_2:15.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_2:15.text: That's wonderful. It seems like you're making positive strides in different areas of your life.

p16/p16_conv_2:16.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_2:16.text: Thanks. I'm trying to keep a positive outlook. It helps to talk it through with someone, so I appreciate you being there.

p16/p16_conv_2:17.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_2:17.text: I'm always here for you, Amanda. It's important to have someone to share these moments with. You're doing great.

p16/p16_conv_2:2.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_2:2.text: Well, a lot has been happening lately, but something unexpected happened at work today.

p16/p16_conv_2:4.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_2:4.text: Remember the conflict I had with a coworker a while back? They actually apologized today.

p16/p16_conv_2:5.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_2:5.text: That's quite significant! How did that make you feel?

p16/p16_conv_2:6.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_2:6.text: Honestly, it was a relief. We've had tension for months, and their apology felt genuine.

p16/p16_conv_2:7.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_2:7.text: I'm really glad to hear that. A genuine apology can make a big difference in working relationships.

p16/p16_conv_2:8.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_2:8.text: Yes, definitely. It's made me hopeful about working together more positively from now on.

p16/p16_conv_2:9.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_2:9.text: That's a great mindset to have. Collaborative work environments can be much more fulfilling.

p16/p16_conv_3:0.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_3:0.text: Hey Amanda, how have you been holding up lately?

p16/p16_conv_3:1.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_3:1.text: Hi, honestly, it's been a tough couple of days. I finally had the big talk with Bill, and we decided to break up.

p16/p16_conv_3:2.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_3:2.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. It sounds like a really difficult decision to come to. Do you want to talk about what happened?

p16/p16_conv_3:3.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_3:3.text: Yeah, it's just... we've been together for three years, but we've been stuck on what our future looks like. Our life goals just don't align anymore.

p16/p16_conv_3:4.speaker: supporter
p16/p16_conv_3:4.text: That must be so hard, especially after investing so much time and emotion into the relationship. How are you feeling about it all?

p16/p16_conv_3:5.speaker: seeker
p16/p16_conv_3:5.text: A mix of emotions, really. I feel sad and a little lost. But there's also relief, you know? Like, at least now I can move forward instead of being in limbo.

9bd39d21ca1103bdf55e4d1425ac874e67ba2c58.head: MP
9bd39d21ca1103bdf55e4d1425ac874e67ba2c58.statement: wants to settle down and take relationship to next level

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Yes, my boy friend of 3 years has refused to take our relationship to the next level and I'm kind of getting tired, I don't want to play games anymore

38a2226dd44144453e3839bf90373e1b82bebe01.head: MP
38a2226dd44144453e3839bf90373e1b82bebe01.statement: experiencing prolonged sadness and emotional distress due to lack of relationship progression

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Yes, sort of and he gave me the impression that he is not there yet and that was a like almost a year ago, I don't want it to look like I'm pushing him if I try to talk to him again about it. His nonchalant attitude in not seeing the seriousness of it is killing me, I'm just not happy.

16335d270f85f76ce1373172ded8d0024db62809.head: MP
16335d270f85f76ce1373172ded8d0024db62809.statement: willing to end relationship if partner does not commit soon

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Yes, I love him so dearly to want to settle down with him, but if he doesn't want that for me I would rather call it quits now than continue and be disappointed at the long run.

49dd54cafd65624b80fadf5794914ff9aaa27770.head: MP
49dd54cafd65624b80fadf5794914ff9aaa27770.statement: in a romantic relationship with boyfriend for 3 years

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Yes, my boy friend of 3 years has refused to take our relationship to the next level and I'm kind of getting tired, I don't want to play games anymore

e8231c3eb17bfb7f8bed1ead8665b990cf15fa06.head: ME
e8231c3eb17bfb7f8bed1ead8665b990cf15fa06.statement: considering ending long-term relationship due to unmet commitment expectations

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Yes, I love him so dearly to want to settle down with him, but if he doesn't want that for me I would rather call it quits now than continue and be disappointed at the long run.

3cb9d3fc24f5afe8816ce934444f340531e284b5.head: ME
3cb9d3fc24f5afe8816ce934444f340531e284b5.statement: felt bittersweet about reconnecting with relatives after years of distance

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: It was bittersweet. On one hand, it was wonderful to reconnect, but on the other hand, it made me realize how distant I've become from them.

052abb2d158df73dac8f6f099da1624e8488dab7.head: ME
052abb2d158df73dac8f6f099da1624e8488dab7.statement: expressed gratitude for support received, noting it helped generate ideas for coping

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Thank you, you have helped a lot

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Helped give me some ideas to try to help

824be02d171aaf595e974f26d685476d1f7898f9.head: ME
824be02d171aaf595e974f26d685476d1f7898f9.statement: received emotional support through chat conversation about grief

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Thnak you, I think it helps to have someone to chat

spans.speaker: seeker
spans.exact_quote: Makes me feel better to chat a bit with you, helped me to relax
